title: Rural Hospital Cyber Incident: 17 Days of Access Went Unseen
content_md: MindCore Technologies writes: A rural hospital cyber incident rarely starts with a locked screen and a ransom note. It usually starts with an outsider moving quietly through the network for days or weeks while clinical work carries on as normal.
